_comment: Render queue for `python -m src.chapters queue`. A unit with no start/stop heading is the whole chapter body (id chNN). A partial unit is trimmed from `start` (inclusive; default: the chapter opener) up to but not including `stop` (default: the end of the body). Headings are matched against the PDF's own text. Order = render order. Units whose output already exists are skipped, never overwritten.
